channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Strait of Hormuz tolls would harm livelihoods worldwide, shipowners warn
item.description: Eight leading shipping organisations sign letter opposing fees in critical waterway.

item.title: Could the Iran war derail Donald Trump’s legacy?
item.description: President Trump is looking to reframe the Iran war ahead of the 2026 midterm elections in November.

item.title: Lightning strike kills Thai footballer during match
item.description: Footage shows the moment a lightning strike hit a football player in southern Thailand, during a semi-final match.

item.title: Iran war live: Trump denies munitions shortages; Tehran, Oman near deal
item.description: Iran, Oman agree on shipping routes in the Strait of Hormuz, as Houthis attack Saudi tankers and Israel bombs Lebanon.

item.title: Mexican influencer shot dead during TikTok livestream
item.description: Cesar Gastelum was killed as he sat in a car park with two others in Culiacan, the capital of Sinaloa state.

item.title: US officials push back on reports of dangerously low munitions supplies
item.description: Experts warn that low stockpiles of air defence interceptors as a result of the war on Iran leave the US vulnerable.

item.title: Iran says deal with Oman on Strait of Hormuz is in final stages
item.description: Neither the US or Oman have commented on the proposed agreement on the vital waterway.

item.title: Israel strikes south Lebanon after first evacuation warning in weeks
item.description: Lebanon's health ministry says one person was killed in the strikes, which the Israeli military says were a response to a Hezbollah ceasefire violation.

item.title: UN rights chief alarmed by rise in Iran executions since March
item.description: Volker Türk says 56 people have been executed on national security-related charges, including 27 in cases linked to January's protests.

item.title: The avalanche that killed a climbing legend - and a generation of record-setting guides
item.description: Their fellow guides say their deaths in Pakistan dealt a devastating blow to Nepal's mountaineering community.
